title: Averaging D^2 Psi along a segment of gradients gives a coercive, bounded, Hoelder bilinear coefficient
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), Psi : L -> R of class C^2, B(P)[Q][Q'] := fderiv R (fderiv R Psi) P Q Q', and lam, eps, M_B, L_B, H, alpha real numbers with L_B >= 0. Assume (a) lam ||Q||^2 <= B(P)[Q][Q] whenever ||P|| <= eps; (b) |B(P)[Q][Q']| <= M_B ||Q|| ||Q'|| whenever ||P|| <= eps; (c) |B(P)[Q][Q'] - B(P')[Q][Q']| <= L_B ||P - P'|| ||Q|| ||Q'|| whenever ||P|| <= eps and ||P'|| <= eps. Let S be a subset of R^n and P0, P1 : R^n -> L with ||P0(x)|| <= eps and ||P1(x)|| <= eps for x in S, and ||Pi(x) - Pi(y)|| <= H ||x - y||^alpha for x, y in S and i = 0, 1. Then there is a map a from R^n to continuous bilinear forms on L (a : Rn n -> L ->L L ->L R) such that a(x)[P][Q] = integral_0^1 B(P0(x) + t(P1(x) - P0(x)))[P][Q] dt for all x in R^n and P, Q in L, and, for all x, y in S and P, Q in L: lam ||P||^2 <= a(x)[P][P]; |a(x)[P][Q]| <= M_B ||P|| ||Q||; |a(x)[P][Q] - a(y)[P][Q]| <= L_B H ||x - y||^alpha ||P|| ||Q||.
